In the SexyKO HYPER Beta, the competition starts on day one. Throughout the Beta, our players can look forward to the Clan ranking, the Job ranking, 4 big Castle Siege Wars and a special NP raffle.

◆ 17 October, Saturday — 22:00 · 🏰 1st Beta CSW
◆ 18 October, Sunday — 22:00 · 🏰 2nd Beta CSW
◆ 20 October, Tuesday — 22:00 · 🏰 3rd Beta CSW
◆ 22 October, Thursday — 22:00 · 👑 Beta Final CSW

🕙 CSW start time: 22:00 · ⏳ Preparation: 10 minutes · ⚔️ Battle: 60 minutes

The CSW preparation phase starts at 22:00. The first 10 minutes are preparation time, then the Castle Siege War begins and the battle lasts up to 60 minutes.

💡 Beta Final CSW (Thursday, 22 October): Just 1 day before the Official launch, the last Castle Siege War of the Beta period will take place.

🏰 03 · CSW REWARDS (EACH CSW)


◆ 🏰 1. Castle Owner Clan → 💵 20,000 TL + 💎 20,000 SB
◆ 👑 2. Clan with Most Stone Captures → 💵 10,000 TL + 💎 10,000 SB
◆ ⚔️ 3. Clan with Most Kills → 💎 20,000 SB

🏆 4 CSW grand total: 💵 120,000 TL cash prize + 💎 200,000 SB

💡 CSW reward rule: In each CSW, a Clan can win a reward from only 1 reward category. Once a Clan wins a reward in any category, it is removed from the other reward categories of the same CSW. This way, the goal is for different Clans to win rewards in each CSW.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

👑 04 · CLAN RANKING REWARDS


◆ 🥇 1st Clan → 💎 30,000 SB
◆ 🥈 2nd Clan → 💎 20,000 SB
◆ 🥉 3rd Clan → 💎 10,000 SB
◆ Total → 💎 60,000 SB

💡 The overall Clan NP ranking at the end of the Beta period will be used. Only the overall Clan ranking counts, regardless of race.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

⚔️ 05 · JOB RANKING REWARDS


Priest • Warrior • Rogue • Kurian • Mage — During the Beta, each Job is ranked separately.

◆ 🥇 Each Job's 1st → 💵 2,500 TL + 💎 2,500 SB + 🗿 Job-exclusive 30 cm physical statue
◆ 🥈 Each Job's 2nd → 💵 1,000 TL + 💎 2,000 SB
◆ 🥉 Each Job's 3rd → 💎 2,000 SB

🎁 06 · 100,000+ NP BETA RAFFLE


Players who earn 100,000 NP or more during the Beta qualify for the special Beta raffle.

◆ 🥇 1st Player → 🗿 Job Statue + 💎 1,000 SB

## 🏆 01 · AT A GLANCE

![]({{O00}})

In the SexyKO HYPER Beta, the competition starts **on day one**. Throughout the Beta, our players can look forward to the **Clan ranking**, the **Job ranking**, **4 big Castle Siege Wars** and a special **NP raffle**.

---

## 📅 02 · BETA CSW SCHEDULE

![]({{O01}})

- **17 October, Saturday — 22:00** · 🏰 1st Beta CSW
- **18 October, Sunday — 22:00** · 🏰 2nd Beta CSW
- **20 October, Tuesday — 22:00** · 🏰 3rd Beta CSW
- **22 October, Thursday — 22:00** · 👑 Beta Final CSW

🕙 **CSW start time: 22:00** · ⏳ **Preparation: 10 minutes** · ⚔️ **Battle: 60 minutes**

The CSW preparation phase starts at 22:00. The first 10 minutes are preparation time, then the Castle Siege War begins and the battle lasts **up to 60 minutes**.

💡 **Beta Final CSW (Thursday, 22 October):** Just 1 day before the Official launch, the last Castle Siege War of the Beta period will take place.

---

## 🏰 03 · CSW REWARDS (EACH CSW)

![]({{O02}})

- 🏰 **1. Castle Owner Clan** → 💵 **20,000 TL** + 💎 **20,000 SB**
- 👑 **2. Clan with Most Stone Captures** → 💵 **10,000 TL** + 💎 **10,000 SB**
- ⚔️ **3. Clan with Most Kills** → 💎 **20,000 SB**

🏆 **4 CSW grand total:** 💵 **120,000 TL cash prize** + 💎 **200,000 SB**

💡 **CSW reward rule:** In each CSW, a Clan can win a reward from only 1 reward category. Once a Clan wins a reward in any category, it is removed from the other reward categories of the same CSW. This way, the goal is for different Clans to win rewards in each CSW.

---

## 👑 04 · CLAN RANKING REWARDS

![]({{O03}})

- 🥇 **1st Clan** → 💎 **30,000 SB**
- 🥈 **2nd Clan** → 💎 **20,000 SB**
- 🥉 **3rd Clan** → 💎 **10,000 SB**
- **Total** → 💎 **60,000 SB**

💡 The overall Clan NP ranking at the end of the Beta period will be used. Only the overall Clan ranking counts, regardless of race.

---

## ⚔️ 05 · JOB RANKING REWARDS

![]({{O04}})

**Priest • Warrior • Rogue • Kurian • Mage** — During the Beta, each Job is ranked separately.

- 🥇 **Each Job's 1st** → 💵 **2,500 TL** + 💎 **2,500 SB** + 🗿 **Job-exclusive 30 cm physical statue**
- 🥈 **Each Job's 2nd** → 💵 **1,000 TL** + 💎 **2,000 SB**
- 🥉 **Each Job's 3rd** → 💎 **2,000 SB**

---

## 🎁 06 · 100,000+ NP BETA RAFFLE

![]({{O05}})

Players who earn **100,000 NP or more** during the Beta qualify for the special Beta raffle.

- 🥇 **1st Player** → 🗿 **Job Statue** + 💎 **1,000 SB**
- 🥈 **2nd Player** → 🗿 **Job Statue**
- 🥉 **3rd Player** → 💎 **1,000 SB**
- 🎖️ **4th Player** → 💎 **500 SB**
- 🎖️ **5th–10th Players** → 💎 **250 SB per player**

---
